newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover surged to 2.539 billion yuan from 760 million yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was more active than Thursday with both short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, and state-run banks participating in the trading, traders said.
"Growing bank deposits have boosted the fund supply, with state-run banks lending on the market," said a trader.
Traders said securities houses were among the most active buyers in trading on Friday.
"The active domestic A share markets and one new issue on the Shenzhen stock exchange were positive factors encouraging the brokerages to buy," said a second trader.
The rates will move narrowly next week, traders said.
